system.description:
Usage held in 1 hand; Weight 4 lbs.

Eshari tradition insists that this lantern has never been extinguished. Sceptics point out that nobody agrees which of several surviving lanterns is actually the original.

The lantern illuminates a 30-foot radius. While carrying it, you gain Spirit Sense 60 feet and may perceive spirits detected by that sense sufficiently clearly to target them. You possess Resistance to essence damage.

Willing allies within the lantern's light gain a +2-status bonus to saving throws against possession and effects with the Soul trait.

You also gain the Open the Last Road and Close the Gate abilities:

Open the Last Road:

Activate 3 AP

Frequency 1/day

Duration 10 minutes

For the duration, willing disembodied spirits within 60 feet may manifest sufficiently to be seen and heard by everyone present. A spirit may end its own manifestation at any time. During the effect, hostile possession attempts originating within the area suffer a -2-status penalty to the relevant check or save DC.

Close the Gate:

Activate 2 AP

You may automatically remove a possessing spirit from target. The spirit is banished and may not possess that target again.

On the sheet: Spirit Sense 60 feet joins your senses; allies within 30 feet carry +2 status against possession and Soul effects as an aura; Use offers Open the Last Road (3 AP, 1/day, 10 minutes) or Close the Gate (2 AP, target the possessed creature). Resistance to essence and the 30-foot light are the table's.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 11.
